title: Azure hub-and-spoke landing zone
description: A connectivity subscription hosts the hub: ExpressRoute and VPN gateways, Azure Firewall Premium, Bastion and private DNS. Production and development landing zones peer their spokes into the hub and send every flow through the firewall; data services are reached over private endpoints. A management subscription holds Log Analytics, Defender for Cloud, Sentinel, Azure Policy and the Recovery Services vault.

attributes.detail: Standard · no public IPs on VMs
